faq.question: What Amazon visual assets do you create?
faq.answer: We create main and secondary images, infographics, lifestyle concepts, and A+ Content design. Scope is set by ASIN priority and Brand Registry access.

faq.question: Do you need physical product samples?
faq.answer: Physical samples improve photography quality for many categories. When samples are unavailable, we define alternative production options during scoping.

faq.question: Are assets built for Amazon image requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. We design to Amazon listing image standards and Brand Registry A+ constraints relevant to your catalog.

faq.question: Can you refresh an existing gallery without a full reshoot?
faq.answer: Often yes. We audit what can be redesigned from current assets versus what needs new photography.

faq.question: How do visuals connect to listing conversion?
faq.answer: Image sequence answers buyer questions quickly. We plan galleries to support click-through, feature understanding, and purchase confidence.

faq.question: Do you also produce video?
faq.answer: Video is delivered through our Video Creative service. Visual and video teams coordinate when listings need both.

faq.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
faq.answer: We support visual work for catalogs selling across official Amazon Seller Central marketplaces: United States, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Sweden, Poland, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, South Africa, India, Japan, Australia, and Singapore. Scope for a specific account is confirmed during your audit consultation.

faq.question: How do I get started?
faq.answer: Submit the free audit form or contact us at +1 (360) 660-1210 or info@ecomgliders.com. Typical next steps are a creative audit, ASIN priority plan, then production and listing integration.
